responsibility: Declares the Xtensa backend’s public interfaces shared across the port’s source files and generated machine-description code. It exposes immediate-fit tests, operand and constant-pool helpers, expansion and emission routines for moves, branches, calls, atomics, block operations, frame/prologue/epilogue handling, register-class queries, debugger register mapping, elimination offsets, and configuration-string access, serving as the central prototype header for xtensa.cc and xtensa.md support code.
